the sheet shows two lines but no spread; 16° puts the lines about 3 m apart at 11 m, roster fans use 12 to 24°
unchanged from the stock tether

forms.name: radial spool
forms.description: The four manipulator arms throw harpoon lines at 90° intervals out to 8 m (800 cm); each deals 142 damage and 20 stability and leashes its target, pulling it 2 m (200 cm) toward Tessa.

hypotheses.rationale: unchanged from the stock tether
four lines at 90° leave a 270° spread between the first and last
the sheet gives no radial range; 8 m keeps the burst a close-quarters tool
Tessa plants the spool while the arms fire, as the roster's rooted casts do
the lines radiate from Tessa, not from the aim point
a longer 3 s hold pays for the shorter reach
matches the 8 m radial reach
2 m beyond the radial reach

dossier.identity: salvage-line breaker who leashes enemies on a harpoon tether, drags them out of position and turns their broken shields into her own.
dossier.selectionRationale: the sheet labels her a breaker with a spool harpoon rifle. tethers and pulls (collision-displacement), lock fields that slow and interrupt, and barriers taken from broken enemy shields make her a guard-breaker who controls where enemies stand, distinct from rook's slam, titania's charge and nixie's gel.
dossier.weaponConcept: harpoon rifle "spooler" (electromagnetic harpoon rifle with a variable-tip harpoon head, a 65 m conductive tether spool drum, a mag-coil emitter rail and four detachable manipulator arms)

lore.backstory: former wreck-yard salvager from the flooded lower transit decks. she rebuilt a scrapped dockyard harpoon gun around a conductive cable spool and bolted four manipulator arms from a dead cargo rig to her spine, so she can reel in anything that floats, falls or runs away.
lore.syndicateRecord: hauled an armoured convoy out of a sinking tunnel line by line, then sold the wreck back to the company that lost it.
lore.psychProfile: easygoing, sharp-eyed and practical; sees every broken thing as stock, every enemy as a delivery that has not arrived yet.
lore.combatQuote: “pieces become possibilities, so hold still while i count yours.”

counterplay: Sidestep or body-block the line; break the leash with 180 damage or stretch it past its reach; stability-immune and displacement-immune targets are not dragged.

forms.name: tether
forms.description: Harpoon line: 11 m (1100 cm), 0.3 m (30 cm) wide, 26 m/s (2600 cm/s); 95 damage and 20 stability, pulls the target 1 m (100 cm) toward Tessa and leashes it within 14 m (1400 cm) for 2 s (60 ticks) until the leash takes 180 damage. Cost 16 · windup 0.47 s (14 ticks) · cooldown 7.5 s (225 ticks).

forms.name: twin tether
forms.description: Fires two harpoon lines across a 16° fan; each carries the full 123 damage, 20 stability and a leash, and pulls its target 1.6 m (160 cm). A target hit by both lines is pulled once.

forms.name: radial spool
forms.description: The four manipulator arms throw harpoon lines at 90° intervals out to 8 m (800 cm); each deals 142 damage and 20 stability and leashes its target, pulling it 2 m (200 cm) toward Tessa.

signature.stock: Plants a lock field up to 9 m (900 cm) away: radius 2 m (200 cm), lasts 5 s (150 ticks), pulses every 1 s (30 ticks) for 45 damage and 8 stability and slows enemies inside by 35% for 1.5 s (45 ticks). Cost 40 · windup 0.73 s (22 ticks) · cooldown 20 s (600 ticks).

channels.label: radius
channels.per: 2 m · 3 m at r3 · three 2 m fields at r5

counterplay: Walk out of the field (the slow is refreshed every pulse, so leave early); stability-immune and unstoppable targets ignore the interrupt; clear the line of fields at their narrow overlap.

forms.name: lockfield
forms.description: Plants a lock field up to 9 m (900 cm) away: radius 2 m (200 cm), lasts 5 s (150 ticks), pulses every 1 s (30 ticks) for 45 damage and 8 stability and slows enemies inside by 35% for 1.5 s (45 ticks). Cost 40 · windup 0.73 s (22 ticks) · cooldown 20 s (600 ticks).

forms.name: interdict field
forms.description: The field grows to 3 m (300 cm) radius and every pulse interrupts enemies inside, cancelling the cast in progress. Pulses deal 58 damage and 8 stability and slow by 44%.

forms.name: triple lockfield
forms.description: Lays three linked lock fields in a line, 3 m (300 cm) apart and 2 m (200 cm) in radius, so their edges overlap and the slow carries between them. Each pulse deals 67 damage and 8 stability, slows by 50% and interrupts.

iconFamily.subject: a bold harpoon trailing a single chunky cable spool
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Tessa. Theme: spool line. Subject: a bold harpoon trailing a single chunky cable spool. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
